## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^epac-6e4659ee28ddf896]

Rank 1 is No actionable strategy: one-price IDR 50 trading, severe participation weakness, bearish structure, −2.3% upstream gross expected return and absent executable stop block entry. Rank 2 rejects the buyback-reaction breakout above about 52.23 because material volume recovery is undefined numerically and no post-announcement completed bar is supplied. With illustrative 53 entry and non-executable 41.41 boundary, even primary-zone upper edge 54 offers about 0.09:1 gross reward-to-risk; the reconstructed 61 reference gives about 0.69:1 and is not established as attainable. A future refreshed plan must define its maximum limit and 3–5 holding-session time stop within original expiry. Absent bids, partial fills, gaps and suspension are explicit risks.[^epac-6e4659ee28ddf896]

The report keeps signals separate from fills: Waiting is the stated cut-off condition; Armed/Triggered need fresh dated observations, Active needs explicit entry execution, and Completed needs fills closing the full position. Target touches or exit deadlines alone do not prove execution. Terminal scenario probabilities cannot establish conditional target/stop/fill probabilities, so strategy expected value is not reliably estimable. Unknown costs are not zero and capital, currency-risk, lot and execution inputs do not support a share quantity.[^epac-6e4659ee28ddf896]
